insights.summary: Niche real estate investing di US didominasi model funnel webinar/free training → high-ticket coaching, bukan produk digital murah. Volume iklan sangat besar pada beberapa pemain (Tyson Smith REI 395 iklan, Logan Fullmer 151, Christian Osgood 128, Success With Section 8 99, stevenbillmas 96) yang terus memperbarui creative, sedangkan iklan evergreen paling lama dimiliki Be Polite Properties, Bearded Realtor Coaching, Matt Beard, dan Women's REIN. Sub-niche terpanas: Airbnb tanpa properti, wholesaling/creative finance, dan coaching agen properti berbasis AI. Pemain non-edukasi (cash home buyer lokal, brokerage recruiting, listing tanah) muncul di hasil keyword tetapi dikecualikan.
